statement: Give Vibez its own buildable source, tests and governance without altering Fantasy Football's running workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: A clean Vibez checkout builds and runs inherited tests, schema/contract checks and adversarial checks independently of the Fantasy Football checkout.
AC-02: An automated inventory/provenance comparison accounts for every included, excluded and intentionally transformed path.
AC-03: Artifact/working-tree scan finds no credentials, live runtime data, stopped canary exchange or unrelated project content.
AC-04: UAT requirements/affected/dependency-contract regressions and current workflow guarantees survive export.
AC-05: Destination CI, licensing decision references and the delta ledger are present; an extraction is not described as new independent review of historical source runs.
